rules.statement: There is no right of appeal from the order made under Section 18(1) of the Agrarian Services Act, No. 58 of 1979 to the Court of Appeal.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 18 of the Agrarian Services Act, No. 58 of 1979 does not provide for nor does it create a Right of Appeal in a tenant cultivator, who is aggrieved by the Order of the Commissioner to pay up his arrears to the Landlord before a stipulated date."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 18 of the Agrarian Services Act, No. 58 of 1979
